script.title: AT THE MUSEUM
script.scene_zh: 美術館 · 售票口購票
script.story_hook: Two happy visitors arrive at the museum doors.
script.intro_zh: 兩位開心的訪客，來到美術館門口。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we buy museum tickets. Listen for times, prices, and discounts.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們去買美術館門票。留意時段、價格與折扣。
script.outro: Tickets ready, art ahead. Enjoy the visit!
script.outro_zh: 門票買好了，藝術在前方。參觀愉快！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each box office line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，我們逐句跟讀售票口的常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a retired man in his late sixties with a short white beard and thin gray hair, wearing a rust orange zip-up sweater, khaki trousers and brown leather shoes, slightly stooped, cheerful
script.char_b_description: a cheerful woman in her early thirties with shoulder-length auburn hair in a loose braid, wearing a plum cardigan over a cream blouse, black slacks and clean white sneakers

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning! Two tickets for today, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔɹnɪŋ tu ˈtɪkɪts fɚ təˈdeɪ pliz/
dialogue.zh: 早安！請給我們兩張今天的門票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning! Entry is timed now. Which slot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔɹnɪŋ ˈɛntɹi ɪz taɪmd naʊ wɪtʃ slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 早安！現在採時段入場。要哪一個時段？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slot? Um… what does that mean, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /slɑt ʌm wʌt dʌz ðæt min ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 時段？呃…這是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick a time: come now, or at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ə taɪm kʌm naʊ ɔɹ æt θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 選個時間：現在進，或是下午三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, got it. Now works — we're early birds.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡɑɾ ɪt naʊ wɜɹks wɪɹ ˈɜɹli bɜɹdz/
dialogue.zh: 噢，懂了。現在就好，我們來得早。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Perfect. Adults, seniors, or students?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ pɜɹfɪkt əˈdʌlts ˈsinjɚz ɔɹ ˈstudənts/
dialogue.zh: 哈！太好了。要全票、長者票還是學生票？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seniors. My wife and I, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈsinjɚz maɪ waɪf ænd aɪ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 兩張長者票。我和我太太，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice. Seniors are nine dollars each.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈsinjɚz ɑɹ naɪn ˈdɑlɚz itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。長者票一張九美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine? That's cheaper than I thought!
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ðæts ˈtʃipɚ ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 九塊？比我想像的便宜多了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wednesdays are half price for everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛdnəz ɑɹ hæf pɹaɪs fɚ ˈɛvɹiˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 週三當天，所有人都享半價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No kidding! Well, we came today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈkɪdɪŋ wɛl wi kmeɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不是吧！好在我們今天就來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lucky you. Is she a member, by the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌki ju ɪz ʃi ə ˈmɛmbɚ baɪ ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 真幸運。對了，她是會員嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Member? Hmm, I think she is! See?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛmbɚ hʌm aɪ θɪŋk ʃi ɪz si/
dialogue.zh: 會員？嗯，我想她是！你看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, members enter free. Got the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ˈmɛmbɚz ˈɛntɚ fɹi ɡɑɾ ðə kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，會員免費入場。卡帶了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The card? Uh… it's in her purse. At home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑɹd ʌ ɪts ɪn hɜɹ pɜɹs æt hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 卡？呃…包裡沒有。落在家中了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. Well, we can look her up.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wɛl wi kæn lʊk hɜɹ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 噢，別擔心。我們可以查她的資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look her up? How do you do that?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk hɜɹ ʌp haʊ du ju du ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 查資料？那要怎麼查？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full name and email. I'll check the system.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl neɪm ænd ˈimel aɪl tʃɛk ðə ˈsɪstəm/
dialogue.zh: 全名和電子郵件。我幫你查系統。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her name is Ellen White. Want it spelled?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜɹ neɪm ɪz ˈɛlən (h)waɪt wɑnt ɪt spɛld/
dialogue.zh: 她叫 Ellen White。要拼給你聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please. W as in water?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ˈdʌbəlju ʔæz ɪn ˈwɔɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，請說。W 是 water 的 W 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: W… H… I… T… E. Like the color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʌbəlju eɪtʃ aɪ ti i laɪk ðə ˈkʌlɚ/
dialogue.zh: W…H…I…T…E。就是顏色的「白」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. White, first name Ellen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt (h)waɪt fɜɹst neɪm ˈɛlən/
dialogue.zh: 記下。姓 White，名字 Ellen？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's her! Forty years of marriage, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts hɜɹ ˈfɔɾi jɪɹz ʌv ˈmæɹɪdʒ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 就是她！結婚四十年嘍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lovely. Typing now… hold on… no match.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌvli ˈtaɪpɪŋ naʊ hoʊld ɑn noʊ mætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。正在輸入…等等…查無資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No match? But she renewed it in spring!
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ mætʃ bʌt ʃi ɹɪˈnjud ɪt ɪn spɹɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 查不到？她春天明明才續費啊！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm. One more try: her phone number?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm wʌn mɔɹ tɹaɪ hɜɹ foʊn ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯。再試最後一招：她的電話號碼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know it by heart. Ready? Four…
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ɪt baɪ hɑɹt ˈɹɛdi fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 我背得起來。準備好了嗎？四…

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I'm typing slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd aɪm ˈtaɪpɪŋ ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 你說，我打字會慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four one five. That's the old Chicago code.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ wʌn faɪv ðæts ði oʊld ʃɪˈkɑɡoʊ koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 四一五。是老芝加哥的區域號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Then seven digits, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ðɛn ˈsɛvən ˈdɪdʒɪts pliz/
dialogue.zh: 記下。接著七個數字，麻煩你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven six two… and oh four nine eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən sɪks tu ænd oʊ fɔɹ naɪn eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 七六二…再來是零四九八。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Typing… hold on… got her! Found it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪpɪŋ hoʊld ɑn ɡɑɾ hɜɹ faʊnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 輸入中…等一下…找到她了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Even names get lost sometimes.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈivən neɪmz ɡɛt lɔst ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 哈！連名字偶爾也會走失。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one sat under her old number. Sorry!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn sæt ˈʌndɚ hɜɹ oʊld ˈnʌmbɚ ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 她的資料留在舊號碼下面。抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So she's a member after all?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃiz ə ˈmɛmbɚ ˈæftɚ ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 所以她終究還是會員？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is! Free entry, plus ten percent off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz fɹi ˈɛntɹi plʌs tɛn pɚˈsɛnt ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 是！她免費入場，商店還打九折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten percent? The gift shop, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn pɚˈsɛnt ði ɡɪf ʃɑp ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 九折？是禮品店對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's it. Now — would you like an audio guide?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ɪt naʊ wʊd ju laɪk ən ˈɔdioʊ ɡaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 就是這間。對了——要語音導覽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's that? A voice that guides you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðæt ə vɔɪs ðæt ɡaɪdz ju/
dialogue.zh: 那是什麼？會說話的導覽機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly! Four dollars, headphones included.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli fɔɹ ˈdɑlɚz ˈhɛdˌfoʊnz ɪnˈklʊdɪd/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯！四美元，附耳機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, please. I follow her around anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn pliz aɪ ˈfɑloʊ hɜɹ əˈɹaʊnd ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一個就好。我反正都跟著她走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Headphones get cleaned every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈhɛdˌfoʊnz ɡɛt kliːnd ˈɛvɹi deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。耳機每天都清潔過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Is the café open for lunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ɪz ðə kæˈfeɪ ˈoʊpən fɚ lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好。咖啡廳午餐時間有開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on level two. No re-entry, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn ˈlɛvəl̩ tu noʊ ˌɹiˈɛntɹi ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 在二樓。不過出去就不能再進。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No going back in? We already ate.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈɡoʊɪŋ bæk ɪn wi ɔlˈɹɛdi eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 不能再進來？我們已經吃過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then perfect. Big bags go in lockers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈpɜɹfɪkt bɪɡ bæɡz ɡoʊ ɪn ˈlɑkɚz/
dialogue.zh: 那正好。大包包要寄存。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lockers? Are they free? Ours is heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɑkɚz ɑɹ ðeɪ fɹi aʊɹz ɪz ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 寄存櫃？是免費的嗎？我們那個很重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free with tickets. Here, two blue tags.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi wɪθ ˈtɪkɪts hɪɹ tu blu tæɡz/
dialogue.zh: 持票免費。給你兩個藍色牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Like this? Click… oh, easy enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs klɪk oʊ ˈizi ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣？喀一聲…噢，滿簡單的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You got it. Water yes, bottles no.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɑɾ ɪt ˈwɔɾɚ jɛs ˈbɑtl̩z noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 對了。水可以帶，水瓶不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. So, where do we start?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd soʊ wɛɹ du wi stɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 懂了。那我們從哪裡開始逛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big stairs, then right for the paintings.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ stɛɹz ðɛn ɹaɪt fɚ ðə ˈpeɪntɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 走大樓梯，右轉就是畫廊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stairs, right. Any guided tours today?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛɹz ɹaɪt ˈɛni ˈɡaɪdɪd taʊɚz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 樓梯、右轉。今天有導覽團嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free docent tours, every half hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ˈdoʊsənt taʊɚz ˈɛvɹi hæf ˈaʊɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有義工導覽，免費，每半小時一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half past? We'll try that one, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf pæst wil traɪ ðæt wʌn ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 四點半那場？那我們來試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you are: paper and digital.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹ ju ɑɹ ˈpeɪpɚ ænd ˈdɪdʒətl̩/
dialogue.zh: 給您：紙本票和電子票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just tap your email, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tæp jʊɹ ˈimel ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只要用手機點一下信，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — tap at the gate, walk in!
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæp æt ðə ɡeɪt wɑk ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對，在閘門上輕點一下，進去吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, miss. You saved our morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju mɪs ju seɪvd ˈaʊɚ ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，小姐。你救了我們一早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Go find the sunflowers. Enjoy!
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɡoʊ faɪnd ðə ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚz ɛnˈdʒɔɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！快去看向日葵。祝參觀愉快！

60句美術館聽力練習：買門票還要選時間？忘記帶會員卡怎麼辦？

這一集跟著一位老先生走進美術館售票口，從時段入場、長者票價、會員折扣，到查詢會員、語音導覽、寄物櫃與參觀動線，一次聽會。

你會聽到：
- 買票、選時段的基本問答
- 拼寫姓名與口報電話號碼的說法
- 查不到會員資料時的小插曲與解法
- 導覽、咖啡廳、寄物與入場規則

You will hear how to buy tickets, pick an entry slot, spell a name, give a phone number, unlock a member discount, and rent an audio guide. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.
